Source: Cetera Investment Management, FactSet, Standard & Poor’s. Data as of 10/3/2025. 17
Valuation Gap
The S&P 500 is trading at 
elevated valuations, with a 
forward P/E ratio of 22.9 versus 
its 15-year average of 17.2. In 
contrast, the S&P 500 Equal 
Weight Index has a P/E of just 
17.2, suggesting more reasonable 
valuations for the average stock. 
A lot of the froth in the headline 
index’s valuations is concentrated 
in larger stocks that carry more 
weight, particularly megacap 
growth names tied to AI.
